scope:
Full local integer consumer comparison on the common source-resident MAC.

The generic RF supply improvement is given to every pruning arm. It is not
the phase-mask mechanism's novelty. This wrapper leaves the original model,
original results, and independent candidate oracle unchanged.
evidence: CPU payload issue/port slots; not RTL/PPA/AEE.
source_staging: RF88..91 holds the current k T10/P2 sources; RF0..79 output accumulators; common24B gather staging/3B collector.

mask_engine_no_pruning.input_contract: Each raw I24 pixel is 2880 contiguous bytes, spatial/T/C order; source-side packing not covered.
mask_engine_no_pruning.common_baseline: Direct V completion, actual V24 spill for post-BN reread.
mask_engine_no_pruning.gold_provenance: Independent candidate oracle, not original capture.

independent_oracle.oracle: Independent NumPy integer matrix execution, legal accumulators <2**47, FP64 exact integer storage; RNE and signed24 saturation at original boundaries.
